html: Sheet modals can be configured to allow scrolling content at all breakpoints, making them ideal for displaying content larger than the viewport. By setting the expandToScroll property to false, the content remains scrollable at every breakpoint. Otherwise, by default, scrolling is only enabled when the sheet modal is fully expanded.

html:
Controller modals are appended to the root of your application, outside of the component that presented them. Component-scoped styles will not reach these modals, so their styles must be applied globally, from a stylesheet that is not scoped to a component.

Inline modals stay where they are declared in your template, so component-scoped styles do apply to them.
Modals expose CSS Custom Properties and CSS Shadow Parts for customizing their appearance.
